title: Show errors in a toast, never a blocking modal
reason: Rejected three times across two projects: twice logged by you and once recorded by the Web agent itself. The Web agent's instructions say nothing about how to show errors.

lesson.title: Errors go in a toast
lesson.description: The Web agent keeps opening a modal dialog for recoverable errors.
lesson.fix: Show recoverable errors with the toast in web/src/components/Toast.jsx. Use a modal only when the user must decide something.
